name: Sports Trivia
subtitle: Sports quiz, one question away
description: Play 10-question sports rounds with 20 seconds per answer. Explore leagues, sporting history and athletes in 52 bundled questions. Keep a daily streak, complete four seasonal chapters and compare your best daily rounds in a local weekly table. Compare scores on this device and exchange scorecards directly. Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show saved progress. Optional Open Trivia DB questions are available in English. Solo play works offline. Free, with no purchases or advertising.
